_about: Maps UVH-26 YOLOv11-S class ids/names (read from the loaded model on 2026-11-23, not from the card) to the TRACEVISION vehicle_type vocabulary. Judgement calls are marked and listed in DECISIONS.md (M6).

model.licence: card: Apache-2.0; Ultralytics YOLO runtime: AGPL-3.0 (PROBLEMS B6)

3.judgement: MUV/MPV (e.g. 7-seaters) has no own class in our vocabulary; mapped to SUV. Matching treats car<->SUV as compatible (half credit).

6.judgement: UVH-26 has no auto-rickshaw class; Three-wheeler also covers e-rickshaws and goods three-wheelers (PROBLEMS B4).

7.judgement: UVH-26 cannot separate motorcycle from scooter. Reported as 'motorcycle/scooter'; counts as correct against either label and matches either in the registry. No split is invented (PROBLEMS B4).

8.judgement: Light commercial vehicle (small goods carriers, pickups) mapped to truck.
